title: ICESat-2 雷射測高衛星
summary: 在重複軌跡分析中扣除橫向偏移遇到地表坡度造成的假高度變化。

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: ICESat-2 利用雷射脈衝量測冰、陸地與其他地表高度。
knowledge.textEn: ICESat-2 uses laser pulses to measure ice, land and other surface elevations.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 在重複軌跡分析中扣除橫向偏移遇到地表坡度造成的假高度變化。
knowledge.textEn: Remove apparent elevation change caused by cross-track displacement over sloping terrain in repeat-track analysis.

knowledge.title: 物理模型與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 小範圍線性地形 z=sx+b，校正變化 Δz真=Δz觀測−sΔx；坡度與位移須同方向。
knowledge.textEn: For locally linear terrain z=sx+b, corrected change Δz_true=Δz_obs−sΔx; slope and displacement directions must match.

quiz.question: 「重複軌跡幾何」：哪一項指出本課需保留的異常機制或替代解釋，不能直接當成驗收成功？
quiz.questionEn: Repeat-track geometry: Which statement identifies an anomaly mechanism or competing explanation that cannot be treated as successful acceptance?
options: Δz真=0.5−0.1×4=0.1 m。線性坡度只在近鄰成立，不能跨裂隙外推。
交付剖面、位移、坡度、校正高度及誤差來源，不把所有差值當冰面增減。
若高度差與橫向偏移相關而與時間無關，優先查地形配準；光子雲異常還須檢查背景與分類。
optionsEn: Δz_true=0.5−0.1×4=0.1 m. Linear slope is local and cannot be extrapolated across crevasses.
Deliver profiles, offsets, slopes, corrected heights and error sources without treating every difference as ice change.
Height difference correlated with cross-track offset rather than time suggests terrain-registration error; abnormal photon clouds also require background/classification checks.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「故障與替代解釋」。若高度差與橫向偏移相關而與時間無關，優先查地形配準；光子雲異常還須檢查背景與分類。 與本階段判準一起判讀：正坡度與正位移產生正的假高度差。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies fault and competing explanation. Height difference correlated with cross-track offset rather than time suggests terrain-registration error; abnormal photon clouds also require background/classification checks. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Positive slope and positive offset produce a positive apparent height difference.

steps.title: 重複軌跡幾何 · 分辨異常成因
steps.titleEn: Repeat-track geometry · Discriminate anomaly causes
steps.objective: 完成「重複軌跡幾何」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Repeat-track geometry and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
若高度差與橫向偏移相關而與時間無關，優先查地形配準；光子雲異常還須檢查背景與分類。
對照「重複軌跡幾何」的名義結果，分別建立物理故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。校正後變化需超過綜合不確定度且不同軌段一致，才提出條件式變化證據。
本階段必須重驗：正坡度與正位移產生正的假高度差。
steps.instructionEn:
Height difference correlated with cross-track offset rather than time suggests terrain-registration error; abnormal photon clouds also require background/classification checks.
Against the nominal Repeat-track geometry result, build competing physical-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Require corrected change to exceed combined uncertainty and agree across segments before proposing conditional change evidence.
Reverify this criterion: Positive slope and positive offset produce a positive apparent height difference.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。若高度差與橫向偏移相關而與時間無關，優先查地形配準；光子雲異常還須檢查背景與分類。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Height difference correlated with cross-track offset rather than time suggests terrain-registration error; abnormal photon clouds also require background/classification checks.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 正坡度與正位移產生正的假高度差。
steps.checkEn: Positive slope and positive offset produce a positive apparent height difference.

steps.title: 重複軌跡幾何 · 驗收並留下交接件
steps.titleEn: Repeat-track geometry · Accept and hand over evidence
steps.objective: 完成「重複軌跡幾何」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Repeat-track geometry and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付剖面、位移、坡度、校正高度及誤差來源，不把所有差值當冰面增減。
在交接件中加入「重複軌跡幾何」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：正坡度與正位移產生正的假高度差。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：在重複軌跡分析中扣除橫向偏移遇到地表坡度造成的假高度變化。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver profiles, offsets, slopes, corrected heights and error sources without treating every difference as ice change.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Repeat-track geometry: Positive slope and positive offset produce a positive apparent height difference.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Remove apparent elevation change caused by cross-track displacement over sloping terrain in repeat-track analysis. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。正坡度與正位移產生正的假高度差。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Positive slope and positive offset produce a positive apparent height difference.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
